hero: Graphite. 32 × 32 × 10 mm, a rounded-square pebble with a keyring slot through one corner.
desk: Chalk, next to the CR2032 it runs on for more than a year. The cell is user-replaceable behind a screw-secured door.
dark: Smoke. The amber status light glows through the translucent button membrane.
exploded: Everything inside, top to bottom: TPU button cap, front shell, acoustic membrane, 4-layer board, CR2032, adhesive ring, rear plate, door gasket, door and screws.
lineup: Three resins, one mold: graphite, chalk and smoke.
